artworks.title: Odysseus and the shade of Tiresias (Attic red-figure pelike, detail)
artworks.description: Odyssey Book 11 on a South Italian vase — the pit of blood, the seer who alone kept understanding among the dead, and the prophecy of Poseidon's wrath and the cattle of the Sun.

artworks.title: Tiresias Appears to Ulysses During the Sacrifice
artworks.description: Over the blood-trench the blind seer rises like smoke given shape, and the hero shrinks back sword in hand — the moment the living must ask the dead the way home.

artworks.title: Odysseus Takes Counsel with Teiresias
artworks.description: Abildgaard's counsel at the trench — Odysseus hearing Tiresias among the dead, Nekyia's prophecy of the road home.

artworks.title: Odysseus and Teiresias
artworks.description: Sweelinck's Dutch underworld — the living hero and the blind seer over the blood-offering of Odyssey Book 11.

artworks.title: Teiresias Foretells the Future to Odysseus
artworks.description: Fuseli's second Nekyia — Tiresias rising to foretell Poseidon's wrath and the cattle of the Sun.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.description: Book 11 — the Nekyia: Odysseus' trench of blood, Tiresias' prophecy, and the parade of the dead.

popCulture.title: Nekyia
popCulture.description: The ritual consultation of the dead — Homer's underworld episode that named a genre of katabasis art.
